authorization_source: User instruction to analyze OOF errors on train only without silently trying another encoder, chunking rule or hyperparameter.
purpose: Describe where and how the rejected frozen E5 challenger differs from the word TF-IDF reference using already-created train-only OOF predictions and embeddings, without fitting, scoring or selecting another model.
predeclared_questions: Which sources, labels and OOF folds contain E5 regressions versus recoveries?
Are E5 regressions descriptively concentrated among records truncated by the frozen 512-token limit?
How do regression and recovery counts vary across fixed pre-truncation token-length buckets?
Does frozen E5 nearest-neighbor geometry align more strongly with source identity than source label, especially among E5 regressions?
Which high-confidence OOF disagreements are suitable for bounded human inspection without turning the diagnostic into tuning?

truncation_diagnostic.tokenizer: Pinned local tokenizer from the frozen E5 snapshot
outputs: counts and transition rates by truncation status
counts and transition rates by fixed token-length bucket
truncation_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive association only; truncation is confounded with source and document type and must not be described as a causal explanation.

nearest_neighbor_diagnostic.space: existing row-wise L2-normalized frozen E5 train embeddings
nearest_neighbor_diagnostic.interpretation: A high same-source rate is evidence of source/style geometry, not proof of why an individual classification was made.

ranking.e5_regression: descending challenger confidence in its wrong prediction, then record_id
ranking.e5_recovery: descending challenger confidence in its correct prediction, then record_id
ranking.both_wrong: descending challenger confidence in its wrong prediction, then record_id

prohibited_operations: generate validation, test or external embeddings
alter the 512-token limit or chunk long texts
try a different encoder, pooling rule, prefix, normalization, C value or threshold
select a new model direction from validation, test or external evidence
change any source label or training eligibility
next_gate: Use the frozen diagnostic to decide whether evidence supports only a data/representation limitation statement. Any new modeling hypothesis requires a separate protocol before computation.
